article.title: Registers, etc., to be evidence.
article.content: The registers, their indices and copies of annual returns maintained under sections 88 and 94 shall be prima facie evidence of any matter directed or authorised to be inserted therein by or under this Act.
article.html:
95Registers, etc., to be evidence.

Section 95 · Chapter VII · page 71 of the Act

The registers, their indices and copies of annual returns maintained under sections 88 and 94 shall be prima facie evidence of any matter directed or authorised to be inserted therein by or under this Act.
